lines: Having broken through the ceiling and come down, a red giant landed with a thunderous sound.
Even Astaroth was taken aback by the sight of it.
It was a humungous, red-painted robot, reminiscent of a fire engine.
However, there was no way that Astaroth, who lived in the Demon World, would know what a fire engine was, so she was simply surprised by its strange, giant body.
「Yomihara Fire Brigade, Division 1, Squad 1! SB-001, AKA “Flame King”! On call after receiving a report from a Hell Knight!!」
「That's right! I've sniffed out a powerful fire coming from you!」
Flame King said, pointed his fist at her, and immediately sprayed water at her.
「Yomihara may be lawless, but there's an exception where fire is concerned. In an underground city, once a big blaze breaks out, the town will be annihilated by smoke and flame.」
「No matter who reports it, we dispatch at once, and put! Out! The fire! That's the Yomihara Fire Brigade!」
Having regained her cool, instead of listening to his speech, Astaroth carefully observed his movements.
「I see. Someone's controlling this from the inside, yes? Are you a human?」
「I'm a demon! This is a mechanical puppet I commandeered from the humans.」
「So this is the power of “science” that the humans use. Fascinating♪」
「Arson is a major crime in Yomihara!!! I, Flame King, will be putting out your flames, lady!!!」
Flame King struck a pose, and then pointed the mouth of his hose at her again.
「Put out my Hellfire, you say? Isn't that amusing♪」
Having completely regained her composure, Astaroth summoned some Hellfire and cast it at him, as if to say, “Try and have a go.”
Her flames, which would melt even Hellish steel, blanketed the room in an instant, and liquefied Flame King's body.
「Ha ha ha! This is fire worth fighting!!」
He emerged from among the flames, without a scratch.
「Flame King's chassis is an ultra-fire-resistant body, developed jointly by the fire authorities of Japan and the UFS!」
「To get through the scenes of ultrahot fires, and rush to the source of them at breakneck speed!」
Flame King puffed out his chest and raised his arms, showing off his red, shining body.
「It's been a rule since time immemorial that arsonists are to be burned at the stake! Come quietly!!」
「You extinguish fires, yet you'll burn me to death? How amusing. Go ahead and try♪」
His huge arm attacked her directly this time.
Astaroth escaped injury by hiding within the flames, but
Without delay, Flame King's water spray began to put those out.
「Hahahahaha! Flame King doesn't just spray water! Its physical might is super-strong too!」
「That's so that, during a fire, it can remove any obstacles and head straight to the source!」
「Those who get in its way will die, spilling their guts out!」
「If you spill my guts, you won't be able to burn me at the stake, you know?」
「I'll burn you at the stake after I've spilled your guts!!!」
Flame King said something pretty barbaric, but Astaroth smiled delightedly.
「This guy who's extremely strong against fire is you, then, Flame King?」
「Fufu, for sure! You also appear to have very powerful flames. Let's hear your name before I burn you to death.」
「I am Astaroth. Astaroth of the Inferno.」
「Astaroth, eh?! For the first time in ages, it looks like I'll be able to have some fun putting out a fire.」
「Your flames, and my firefighting! This will be a contest to see which is stronger!!!」
